metadata.row_policy: no target-campaign latency row exists or is bound. TTFT comes from the same-geometry measured A3 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B prefill row (MTP-independent); the decode step is composed from the measured MTP1 attention/GDN/body rows with a declared structural MTP3 transform. Every source row is hash-pinned in the cells manifest and refused on a foreign hardware key, a foreign geometry or an unmeasured band.
metadata.transfer_model: mindie_sim/a3_qwen36_moe_transfer.py: q_len 2->4 scales attention and GDN by 2; the body's M-dependent device classes scale by sqrt(measured b4/b1 body device growth) = the 2x-M factor; two extra MTP draft calls are priced from the measured MTP-head device share plus launch/(layers+1); TPOT = step / declared acceptance. No coefficient is fitted to the eight target cells.
